Long-dated port or pipeline concession contracts (>25 years remaining) with natural monopoly gateway characteristics and contractual tariff autonomy.

Ring-fenced operational subsidiaries upstream robust dividends to service holding company debt without structural entrapment.

verdict.stance: Underweight / Volume Recovery Lag & Liquidity Draw (B- Neg / B3 Neg)
verdict.summary: Fitch (Sep-26 B- Negative) and Moody's (late-26 B3 Negative) flagged that 1H26 EBITDA and container volumes at LimakPort İskenderun tracked below budget amid Red Sea/Middle East disruptions, drawing liquidity from ~$95m (YE25, post-$105m insurance receipts) to ~$58m by mid-26. Debt sustainability on the ~$346m 9.50% Jul-36 notes (XS2339789732) depends on throughput recovery.

positives: Strategic eastern Mediterranean deep-water port concession (İskenderun) serving industrial/reconstruction hinterland.
USD-linked port tariff framework provides natural currency hedge for the $370m 2036 senior secured notes.
Insurance proceeds and internal cash support grain berth reconstruction capex.
negatives: Fitch Negative Outlook (Sep-26): H1 2026 trading fell below budget with EBITDA margin contraction.
High sensitivity to Middle East/Red Sea/Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions and regional conflict.
Single-asset concentration risk (post-2023 earthquake damage & ongoing reconstruction execution).

background.business_overview: Operator of the Port of İskenderun (Limak İskenderun Uluslararası Liman İşletmeciliği A.Ş.) under a long-term TCDD concession.
background.asset_perimeter: Container, general cargo, ro-ro, and grain berth terminals in İskenderun Bay, southeastern Turkey.
background.ownership_governance: Limak Group port concession; $370m senior secured project/corporate notes due July 2036.

recent_drivers: Sep-26: Fitch affirmed $370m 9.50% Jul 2036 senior secured notes at 'B-' with Negative Outlook.
H1 2026: Performance trailed budget due to regional conflict; non-container volume shifts and tariff adjustments expected to partially stabilize FY26 margins.
